messages:
Aj: Heads up — sampleapp e2e flaky when invoking tool calls via SDK helper. Seeing double-encoded JSON payloads after retry.
Maria: repro log?
Aj: pasted log:
```
INFO: sending fn_call {"name":"upsert", "args":"{\"id\":\"123\"}"}
... retry triggered due to auth refresh
INFO: sending fn_call {"name":"upsert", "args":"\"{\\\"id\\\":\\\"123\\\"}\""}
```
Sam: ah, looks like the SDK retry wrapper stringifies args again when a token refresh happens mid-request.
Nikita: we had a similar race in 0.12.3 — fixed in 0.12.4 where retries preserve original payload type. Which SDK version?
Aj: 0.12.3, confirmed.
Maria: immediate workaround: unwrap with JSON.parse on our handler side or pin to 0.12.4. Not great but unblocks.
Sam: I'll draft a minimal patch: detect if args is a stringified JSON and avoid re-stringifying on retry. PR incoming.
Aj: thanks — tagging @Nikita for design/compat review.
ci-bot: deploy queued for branch/retry-fix (build #142) :rocket:
Nikita: design ack. Two asks: 1) ensure deterministic behavior across Node/Py SDKs (parity), 2) add unit + e2e that simulate auth refresh during streaming fn_call.
Maria: +1 on parity tests — our sampleapp CI should include both SDKs in matrix. Also add a linter rule to catch double-encode patterns in helper code.
Sam: PR #271 opened with change and a unit test that simulates a refresh mid-send. I also added a small integration test that runs sampleapp flow.
Aj: verified PR locally against the sampleapp flow — output args restored to object shape and downstream upsert succeeds.
Maria: filing a short SDK changelog entry and note in sampleapp README about recommended pin/upgrades.
Nikita: one more note: avoid any silent coercion. If payload is a Buffer/Stream we should not attempt stringify. Add a guard in the retry helper.
Sam: added guard and expanded tests for Buffer case.
Aj: great. I'll add a follow-up issue for perf: large arg stringify copies can be expensive — maybe switch to stream-friendly path.
Nikita: opened issue #598 to track perf work and streaming concat alternative.
Aj: thanks everyone — leaving this thread as the reconciled troubleshooting log for future hits. :memo:
Maria: resolving for now, please reopen if it recurs. :thumbsup:
